features.title: Create by chat
features.body: Describe what you want and refine it one message at a time. Attach a photo and edit by talking: change hair, swap backgrounds, restyle anything.

features.title: Two engines, one chat
features.body: Generate with Google's Nano Banana (Gemini) and OpenAI's GPT image models. Switch between them without leaving the conversation.

features.title: Control the output
features.body: Batch up to 10 images per request, pick Low to High quality, set custom sizes, and export PNG, JPEG, or WebP with transparent backgrounds.

features.title: See the cost up front
features.body: The credit cost shows before you create, and your balance stays in the toolbar. No weekly trap, no renewals, no surprise charges.

features.title: Synced across devices
features.body: Start anonymously, then sign in with Apple, Google, or GitHub to keep your images in sync across iPhone and iPad.

features.title: Private by default
features.body: Your images are yours alone. There is no public feed, nothing you make is shown to other users, and you can delete anything with one tap.

howItWorks.body: Type what you want in plain words, or attach a photo to edit, and send it like a chat message.
Reply to nudge the result: change the style, fix a detail, or adjust quality and size until it lands.
Save as PNG, JPEG, or WebP, or share it anywhere from the share sheet. It stays private unless you send it.

faq.a: No. There are no subscriptions and no renewals. You buy credit packs once and spend them as you create, and credits never expire.
The app is free to download and includes 25 free credits to start. After that you buy credit packs, with bigger packs carrying up to 68% bonus credits. The credit cost is shown before each creation.

faq.q: Which AI models does it use?
faq.a: PixiePocket generates with Google's Nano Banana (Gemini) and OpenAI's GPT image models. You can use both from the same chat.

faq.q: What happens to my prompts and photos?
faq.a: Your prompts and attached photos are sent to Google Gemini and OpenAI to generate the images. You approve this in-app before your first creation and can withdraw consent anytime in Settings.

faq.q: Do I need an account to use it?
faq.a: No. You can start anonymously. To sync your images across devices, sign in with Apple, Google, or GitHub.

faq.q: Can I edit my own photos with AI?
faq.a: Yes. Attach a photo and edit it by chatting: change hair, swap backgrounds, or restyle the whole image.
PixiePocket runs on iPhone and iPad with iOS 16.6 or later.

faq.q: What are the limits on each image?
faq.a: You can batch up to 10 images per request, choose Low, Medium, High, or Auto quality, set custom sizes from square to widescreen, and export with transparent backgrounds. Some prompts may be filtered by content moderation.

faq.q: Is PixiePocket available in my language?
faq.a: Yes. The app and its App Store page are localized in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.
